summary: Documentation links in the TypeScript SDK reference dead URLs at https://docs.temporal.io/concepts/* which have been reorganized. The correct URLs are now at https://docs.temporal.io/workflow-execution/* with appropriate anchors.
userImpact: Users cannot access referenced documentation to understand SDK APIs, hindering learning and development.
rootCause: Documentation structure was reorganized from /concepts/ to /workflow-execution/ but SDK code comments were not updated with new URLs.
proposedFix: Update all documentation links in code comments from https://docs.temporal.io/concepts/* to https://docs.temporal.io/workflow-execution/* with appropriate anchors.
workaround: Users can access archived versions via web.archive.org or manually search for documentation on docs.temporal.io.
keyQuote: I believe the correct link would be https://docs.temporal.io/workflow-execution/continue-as-new#continue-as-new
